title: What It Actually Looks Like for a Godly Man to Cry and Still Be the Strong One
caption:
Somebody told you a strong man doesn't cry. Jesus didn't get that memo.

At Lazarus's tomb He knew the ending, and He still wept. Then He raised the dead.

Strong isn't numb. Numb is just delayed, and what you bury at the funeral comes back as anger or a bottle or a screen.

Cry to God first. Then walk back in and hold your family up. Let one brother see it.

“Jesus wept.” John 11:35

Save this for the week you need it.

#faith #godlyman #christianmen #grief #strength
theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
